segment.source: Numbers and short codes on a plan view, plus a cabinet schedule, from the Kitchen Wizard cabinet data and hardware tags.
Make a plan sheet with cabinet numbers, codes and a schedule.
Add hardware tags (trash RO, LeMans, UC wine and so on) to picked cabinets.
Make an elevation sheet: a number on every cabinet, text only for hardware and spec'd items.
Make a sheet of side sections through each spec'd or hardware cabinet; the cut lines show on plan and elevation sheets.
Delete the section objects made by Plan Callouts - Sections in this session.
